name: Chicken Marsala Skillet
ingredients_verbatim: 8 ounces cremini mushrooms sliced fairly thin
why: Chicken cutlets seared then finished in a creamy mushroom-marsala pan sauce - a one-pan skillet saute with a light flour dredge only (no rice/pasta/potato/bread base). Published 428 cal / 26g protein / 11g carbs is in-band (above the 400 floor, carbs well under 35) though at the lower calorie end; nutrition READ from the page. Not in the catalog at all - a whole-muscle chicken pan-sauce dish distinct from the rice bowls and curries. Ingredients map to chicken-breast, garlic-powder, flour, olive-oil, butter, mushrooms, minced-garlic, heavy-cream; marsala wine has no board home (board carries white-wine and red-wine but not marsala) - a deliberate pricer-lane flag. Weigh-and-divide skillet, scales cleanly to 14 servings.
